semantics: Use a small closed fault-family enum. Choose the single best family for the primary root cause. Put mechanism details in root_cause.description.

values.name: none
values.description: No fault observed; healthy baseline or no diagnosable injected issue.

values.name: availability
values.description: The component is unavailable or returns an unsuccessful response that prevents the operation from completing.

values.name: latency
values.description: The operation succeeds too slowly or degrades due to latency or resource pressure.

values.name: data
values.description: The payload, state, or response body is empty, malformed, truncated, corrupted, or otherwise unusable.

values.name: contract
values.description: The producer and consumer disagree on a schema, event, cookie, or interface contract.

values.name: auth
values.description: Authorization or authentication failure blocks the flow.

values.name: asset
values.description: A static asset or browser/runtime loading surface is blocked, missing, or served incorrectly.

values.name: compound
values.description: Multiple independent faults materially contribute. Use this only when no single fault is sufficient as the primary root cause.
